params.name: phone_number
params.description: An E.164 formatted phone number to look up.

params.name: type
params.description: Optional lookup features to include. Currently supports `cnam` to retrieve the caller ID name (requires enablement on your account).

items.docs: Returns intelligence about a phone number - line type, current and original carrier (network) info, ported / temporary flags, and optionally the caller name (CNAM). Useful for number validation and anti-fraud enrichment.
